_note: 2026-09-28 owner-approved restoration of intraday strategy trade settings on all seven accounts; global entries are seed-once and do not override later risk-guard disarms. The per-account restoration is independently recorded in strategy-pins.json.
_seedOnce: Each key is applied AT MOST ONCE, recorded per key. This is deliberate and it matters: if the edge watchdog or the adaptive breaker later disarms one of these on measured evidence, the next boot must NOT put it back. An arm that reasserts itself every boot is a guard whose trigger can never hold — the exact shape CLAUDE.md failure mode #3 names. The owner ordered an ARM, not an exemption from the risk controls. To arm again after a disarm, bump the key's entry (see _reseed) or use the route once the token returns.
_reseed: Appending a suffix after a colon makes a NEW seed record for the same strategy — e.g. "tsmom_long:2" re-arms tsmom_long once more without disturbing the first record. The suffix is stripped before the key is used.
